experience.title: The Shift
experience.intro: Four milestones that shaped the way I think about products.

stage1.title: Problems without a template
stage1.lens: Math • Quang Trung High School for the Gifted
stage1.desc: Years of studying advanced Mathematics taught me not to shy away from hard problems. When faced with ambiguity, my first instinct is to dig deeper and find the underlying logic—not memorize a formula.
stage1.takeaway: Think from first principles: Break problems down to their fundamentals before looking for answers.

stage2.title: Learning how code & systems work
stage2.desc: Long nights debugging major projects at HCMUT gave me a practical view of how software works: getting code to run is one thing; building systems that scale and stay maintainable is another.
stage2.takeaway: Understand technology deeply to know its limits and speak the same language as engineers.

stage3.title: When a feature gets ignored
stage3.desc: Building a real-world app and watching users drop off from features I spent weeks coding taught me a hard lesson: great code means little if it solves the wrong problem.
stage3.takeaway: Shift the question: Don't just ask 'how do we build it?' Ask 'why would people use it?'

stage4.title: Owning the product end to end
stage4.desc: I bring together mathematical thinking, technical foundations, and AI to take ownership of the product journey—from shaping a rough idea to crafting the final experience.
stage4.takeaway: Turn complex technology into simple digital experiences that create real value.

toolbox.title: Supporting Skills
toolbox.intro: Practical skills demonstrated through real products and hands-on projects.

ga4.title: Conversion Funnel Analysis & Anomaly Detection
ga4.description: Analyzed the multi-channel purchase journey, identified Mobile Checkout friction around shipping fees and credit cards, and uncovered ~40K anomalous bot sessions to protect data accuracy.
ga4.takeaway: Quantified experience friction and proposed data-driven improvements to conversion.

powerbi.title: Data Visualization & Product Mix Analysis
powerbi.description: Used SQL to explore data and define extraction requirements for the Data team. Built a Power BI dashboard to visualize revenue, profit, and performance across product lines.
powerbi.takeaway: Enabled data-driven decisions: scale the strong-performing Standard line while reducing focus on the less effective Tourist line.

prd.title: PRDs, User Stories & Use Case Specifications
prd.description: Translated user problems into PRDs, broke down the backlog into User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria, and bridged business logic with engineering.
prd.takeaway: Create shared understanding between Business and Engineering before development begins.

sql.title: Data Queries & Business Performance Analysis
sql.description: Built multi-table SQL queries to extract revenue by branch and key operational KPIs, enabling independent performance analysis.
sql.takeaway: Leverage structured data to generate quantitative insights without relying entirely on the data team.

erd.title: Business Flow & Database Modeling
erd.description: Designed a normalized E-ERD and modeled automated business rules for membership points, promotions, and inventory updates to maintain system integrity.
erd.takeaway: Understand the data foundation to collaborate effectively with Backend and Solution Architecture teams.
